reason: I already find our date nights on Instagram and just DM the venue or use the link in bio, and that costs me nothing extra. On my budget I'm not downloading a new app to pay R8 more for something I can already do.
objection: R8 on top of every booking adds up, and it's gone even if I cancel. Two date nights a month for two people is a fee I don't pay now, and adding R5 just to get the ticket on WhatsApp feels like nickel-and-diming.
would_change_my_mind: If a date-night thing I saw on Instagram could only be booked through TROVE, or the fee was dropped for a first booking so I could try it once.
